subject: Request to defer demo for full workload validation and travel alignment
messages:
From: Caroline Wu <c.wu@finlytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: demo@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-10-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Finlytics / Redwood demo - proposed 10/22

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on availability. We'd like to lock in a 60-minute demo on Friday, Oct 22 at 10:00 AM PT to review the planned inference flow for our risk-scoring pipeline. The attendees on our side will be myself, our ML lead (Samir Patel), and our infra lead (Rae Torres).

Can you confirm that your team can cover:
- data ingestion and transform for our historical snapshots
- live inference latency expectations with representative traces
- any network/KMS considerations for private deployments

We'll try to attach a small sample dataset (anonymized) ahead of time — I'll ask our IT to share a Drive link. If that doesn't get to you in time, is there a fall-back slot next week?

Appreciate it,
Caroline Wu
Head of Platform Partnerships
Finlytics

Attachments: none (sample data to follow)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Caroline Wu <c.wu@finlytics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics / Redwood demo - proposed 10/22

Hi Caroline — thanks for the note and the attendee list. Quick heads up: our lead infra engineer who owns the KV cache and private deployment runbook is traveling on the 22nd and won't be available for a deep-run demo. Given the complexity of your workload and our desire to validate using your traces and prompt sets (so we can show representative latency and token-cost numbers), we'd prefer to move the session to give us time to:

- ingest your sample data and run our preflight validation (we typically need 48-72 hours for a small sample + traces)
- run a set of representative prompt sets through the pipeline and surface any formatting/access gaps
- confirm network and KMS test connectivity for your infra lead

Could we propose shifting to one of these options:
- Tue, Oct 27 at 10:00 AM PT
- Thu, Oct 29 at 09:00 AM PT

If those don't work we can propose the following week as well. Also, to make the prep useful, could you ask your team to share: a 5–10k-row anonymized sample (CSV), a small set of workload traces (jsonl), and any IP ranges/KMS domain for access verification? Drop links or send to rishi.malhotra@redwood.com.

I'm attaching our internal runbook stub and a short checklist so both sides are aligned on prep steps. We'll also send a calendar invite once we agree on the date.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-runbook.pdf (runbook stub), prep-checklist.txt (inline below)

--- prep-checklist.txt ---
1) Finlytics: share sample_datasets.csv and workload_traces.jsonl
2) Redwood: validate traces and run baseline latency test on dedicated config
3) Both: confirm attendee list and who will present each section
4) FT IT: provide network/CIDR and KMS contact for preflight
-----------------------

From: Caroline Wu <c.wu@finlytics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: demo@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-10-19T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics / Redwood demo - proposed 10/22

Vivek — thanks, that makes total sense. Rae and Samir are tied up on the 22nd as well, so shifting is fine. We can do Thu, Oct 29 at 09:00 AM PT (that works for the core team).

I asked our security team to produce the anonymized CSV and a small jsonl of traces; they'll upload to the Drive folder by EOD tomorrow and give access to rishi.malhotra@redwood.com. I'll also include the CIDR block and the KMS contact.

Two small asks:
- Can you confirm the duration (we planned for 60 minutes) and whether you'd like us to prepare any slides on our side?
- Do you need an NDA amendment or data processing addendum signed before we upload the sample?

Best,
Caroline

Attachments: none (drive link to follow)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Caroline Wu <c.wu@finlytics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics / Redwood demo - proposed 10/22

Caroline — perfect, Thu Oct 29 at 09:00 AM PT is confirmed for a 60-minute session. I've created a placeholder calendar invite and will update it with the final agenda once we receive the traces. Agenda (proposed):

0:00–0:05 — Intros and objectives (Caroline + Vivek)
0:05–0:25 — Data ingest & preflight results (Rishi)
0:25–0:45 — Live inference demo with your traces (Rishi + Laura)
0:45–0:55 — Network/KMS and deployment considerations (Laura)
0:55–1:00 — Next steps & mutual action items

Prep notes for your team (so we hit the above during the session):
- Please upload sample_datasets.csv and workload_traces.jsonl to the shared Drive and grant access to rishi.malhotra@redwood.com by Oct 21 EOD.
- If there are any IP/CIDR rules or KMS domains, include them in the same folder or share via email to our infra contact.
- One slide with three bullets on your success criteria will help focus the demo.

No NDA amendment required for the anonymized sample in our typical process; if your legal team flags anything, send it to laura.bennett@redwood.com and we can turn around a short DPA.

I'll attach the runbook and sample checklist to the calendar invite. Looking forward to it — we want to make the session as actionable as possible.

Cheers,
Vivek
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: sample_datasets.csv (placeholder), workload_traces.jsonl (placeholder), redwood-runbook.pdf (attached in invite)
